intro.label: ✦ Our Work
intro.heading: 300+ Projects Delivered Across 30+ Industries
intro.description: From early-stage startups to enterprise brands, we've helped businesses build digital products that grow users, increase revenue, and create lasting impact. Every case study here reflects a real partnership, a real challenge, and a real result.

caseStudies.title: Municipal Council Hanumangarh
caseStudies.description: Designed and developed a modern digital municipal platform to improve citizen engagement, streamline public services, and provide faster access to online government services with an enhanced user experience.
caseStudies.challenge: The existing municipal website had outdated design, slow performance, limited accessibility, and difficulty for citizens in accessing important services and information online.
caseStudies.solution: We redesigned and rebuilt the platform with a modern responsive interface, optimized performance, improved navigation structure, and integrated online citizen services for seamless digital governance.

caseStudies.title: Kinetic Renewables Group Website
caseStudies.description: Developed a modern corporate website for Kinetic Renewables Group to showcase renewable energy initiatives, improve global brand presence, and deliver a seamless browsing experience across devices.
caseStudies.challenge: The previous website lacked modern design standards, had slow performance, and did not effectively communicate the company's renewable energy vision and global projects.
caseStudies.solution: We redesigned the website with a clean corporate UI, optimized performance, implemented responsive layouts, and structured content to better highlight projects, sustainability goals, and company achievements.

caseStudies.title: KeepDiving Community App
caseStudies.description: Developed a social community mobile application for divers to connect, share experiences, and explore diving locations worldwide with a seamless and engaging user experience.
caseStudies.challenge: The client required a scalable social platform where divers could share posts, interact with the community, and access diving-related content through a smooth mobile experience.
caseStudies.solution: We designed and developed a modern mobile app with social feed functionality, real-time interactions, optimized media handling, and an intuitive UI to enhance community engagement.

caseStudies.title: Global Parcel Tracking & Shipment Monitoring Platform
caseStudies.description: Developed a real-time parcel tracking platform enabling users to monitor shipments globally with live tracking, shipment visibility, and secure logistics management.
caseStudies.challenge: The existing system lacked real-time shipment visibility, had complex navigation, and users faced difficulty tracking parcels across multiple locations.
caseStudies.solution: We built a streamlined tracking platform with real-time shipment updates, optimized backend APIs, improved UI navigation, and secure monitoring features for global logistics operations.

caseStudies.title: Phere Saath Matrimonial & Matchmaking Platform
caseStudies.description: Designed and developed a modern matrimonial platform enabling users to create profiles, connect securely, and discover compatible matches through an intuitive and user-friendly interface.
caseStudies.challenge: The platform required a secure and scalable matchmaking system with easy profile management, smooth login experience, and improved usability for users across devices.
caseStudies.solution: We built a responsive matrimonial platform with secure authentication, optimized profile browsing, advanced search features, and a modern UI to enhance user interaction and matchmaking efficiency.

caseStudies.title: Cedur Employee Attendance & Payroll Management System
caseStudies.description: Developed a centralized HR management platform to streamline employee attendance, payroll processing, and workforce administration through an intuitive dashboard and automated workflows.
caseStudies.challenge: Manual attendance tracking and payroll calculations were time-consuming, error-prone, and lacked centralized employee data management.
caseStudies.solution: We built an integrated HR platform featuring attendance tracking, payroll automation, employee management modules, and reporting dashboards to simplify HR operations.

caseStudies.title: AstroJyotish Astrology Consultation & Prediction App
caseStudies.description: Developed a mobile astrology platform enabling users to access personalized horoscope insights, astrology consultations, and spiritual guidance through a seamless and user-friendly mobile experience.
caseStudies.challenge: Users required a reliable and easy-to-use astrology platform with secure login, personalized predictions, and smooth mobile performance across devices.
caseStudies.solution: We designed and developed a responsive mobile app with secure authentication, optimized performance, intuitive UI, and personalized astrology features to enhance user engagement.

caseStudies.title: AI-Powered Product Scanning & Recognition Mobile App
caseStudies.description: Developed an AI-driven mobile application that allows users to scan products using camera or uploaded images to instantly identify items and retrieve relevant product information.
caseStudies.challenge: Users needed a fast and accurate way to identify products through mobile devices without manual searching or complex input methods.
caseStudies.solution: We implemented AI-based image recognition with real-time camera scanning, optimized processing pipelines, and an intuitive mobile interface for seamless product identification.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Project timelines vary by scope. A mobile app typically takes 4–8 months, while complex enterprise platforms can take 10–14 months. We provide a detailed timeline during the discovery phase.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups or only enterprises?
faqs.answer: We work with both. We've helped early-stage startups launch their MVP in 3 months and helped enterprise clients rebuild legacy systems at scale.

faqs.question: What industries do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: FinTech, HealthTech, E-Commerce, EdTech, Real Estate, and Logistics are our core verticals — but we've successfully delivered projects across 12+ industries.

faqs.question: Can I see more detailed case study documentation?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. For NDA-protected projects we share detailed decks on request. Contact us and we'll arrange a walkthrough call with the project lead.

faqs.question: What happens after the project is delivered?
faqs.answer: We offer 3–6 months of post-launch support, performance monitoring, and iterative improvement cycles as part of all our engagement packages.
